The '''Teth system''' was a [[star system]] located in the [[Baxel sector]] of [[Wild Space]], at grid square U-16 on the [[Standard Galactic Grid]]. The system contained a single [[star]] [[orbit]]ed by the [[jungle]] [[planet]] [[Teth]] and its two [[moon]]s. In [[40 BBY]], [[Jedi Master]] [[Qui-Gon Jinn]] and his [[Padawan]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi]] were sent on a [[mission to Teth]]. There, the two investigated and prevented [[Hutt]]s from attacking agricultural shipments on the [[Triellus Trade Route]].

Later, during the [[Clone Wars]], the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems]] brought the son of [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure]] to Teth. As a result, the [[Galactic Republic]] launched an [[Battle of Teth|attack]] led by [[Jedi General]] [[Anakin Skywalker]] against the Separatist forces on the surface, where Skywalker and his Padawan, [[Ahsoka Tano]], managed to rescue the Huttlet. Sometime later in [[21 BBY]], Teth served as the site of a [[Showdown on Teth|skirmish]] between [[bounty hunter]] [[Cad Bane]] and Jedi Kenobi and [[Quinlan Vos]].

==Description==
The Teth system was a [[star system]] located in the [[Baxel sector]], which straddled both the [[Outer Rim Territories]] and [[Wild Space]], with the Teth system located in the latter.<ref name="BMF 94" /> Situated along the [[Triellus Trade Route]], it lay in grid square U-19 on the [[Standard Galactic Grid]],<ref name="TFABG" /> and contained the [[jungle]] [[planet]] [[Teth]] and its two [[moon]]s, which [[orbit]]ed the system's single [[star]].<ref name="BMF 94" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Teth system first appeared in the new ''[[Star Wars]]'' [[canon]] in the [[Star Wars: The Clone Wars (film)|''Star Wars: The Clone Wars'']] theatrical film,<ref name="TCW film" /> which was released on [[August 14]], [[2008]].<ref name="australianrelease">{{WebCite|url=http://hoyts.ninemsn.com.au/movie/3095.asp|text=Star Wars: The Clone Wars|archivedate=20081014101639}}</ref> The [[Teth system/Legends|Teth system]] originally appeared in the [[Star Wars Legends|''Star Wars'' Legends]] continuity in the [[Star Wars: The Clone Wars (junior novelization)|junior novelization]] of the ''Star Wars: The Clone Wars'' film, authored by [[Tracey West]]<ref name="TCW junior">[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars (junior novelization)|''Star Wars: The Clone Wars'' junior novelization]]</ref> and published on [[July 26]], [[2008]].<ref name="Amazon">{{PenguinBooks|group=1|url=nf/Book/BookDisplay/0,,9780448449920,00.html|text=Star Wars: The Clone Wars}}</ref>
